title: Transfer learning applications for autoencoder-based anomaly detection in wind turbines
problem_type: anomaly detection / condition monitoring (autoencoder NBM + transfer learning)
real_world_setting: two offshore wind farms, German North Sea
datasets_and_size: 10-min SCADA, multi-year; WF A 240 sensors, WF B 30 sensors; 10+6 turbines modelled; 3 failure case studies
claimed_novelty: Autoencoder normal-behaviour models trained on one or several turbines can be transferred to a new turbine with 1-3 months of target data by re-tuning the whole model, the decoder, or only the threshold.

title: Fault detection in new wind turbines with limited data by generative transfer learning
problem_type: fault detection with scarce data (CycleGAN domain mapping for NBMs)
real_world_setting: 7 wind turbines from 7 distinct wind farms (same manufacturer)
datasets_and_size: 10-min SCADA of 7 WTs, 12-h windows x 11 channels; target training data limited to 1-8 weeks
claimed_novelty: Uses CycleGAN-style domain mapping so that a normal-behaviour model of a data-rich turbine can monitor a new turbine with only weeks of data.

title: Reproducibility of machine learning-based fault detection and diagnosis for HVAC systems in buildings: An empirical study
problem_type: meta-research: reproducibility of ML-based FDD for HVAC
real_world_setting: published literature (database search)
datasets_and_size: 65 primary studies coded on reproducibility variables
claimed_novelty: First systematic audit of how reproducible ML-based HVAC fault detection studies are, scoring disclosure of data, code and evaluation details.

title: Systematic evaluation of TabPFN-TS and Chronos-2 for zero-shot heat load forecasting in district heating networks
problem_type: heat load forecasting (zero-shot time-series foundation models)
real_world_setting: two German district heating networks (Munich, Flensburg)
datasets_and_size: hourly network heat load; Munich 2023 train / 2024 test (non-public); Flensburg public 2020-2024 data for external validation
claimed_novelty: Systematic zero-shot evaluation of TabPFN-TS and Chronos-2 against trained baselines for probabilistic district heat load forecasting, with a foundation-model-based residual-correction variant.

title: A deep learning framework for heat demand forecasting using time–frequency representations of decomposed features
problem_type: heat demand forecasting (time-frequency CNN)
real_world_setting: district heating: 3 Danish metering areas, a Danish city (Aalborg), a German city (Flensburg)
datasets_and_size: hourly heat demand; DMAs 2016-2019 (872/219/364 daily samples), Flensburg 8 years, Aalborg ~3 years / 3021 units
claimed_novelty: Turns decomposed demand and weather series into wavelet scalograms so that a 2D CNN can forecast day-ahead district heat demand.

title: Forecasting residential heating and electricity demand with scalable, high-resolution, open-source models
problem_type: building-level probabilistic heating/electricity demand forecasting; heat pump detection
real_world_setting: residential buildings, US Mid-Atlantic utility territory
datasets_and_size: hourly AMI gas and electricity data ~1 year (2022-2023); 60,000 buildings per application (30k/15k/15k split); heat pump rebate labels
claimed_novelty: Open-source MLP with zero-inflated gamma output that forecasts hourly building-level heating and electricity demand from remote-sensing and geospatial features.

title: Real-world validation of safe reinforcement learning, model predictive control and decision tree-based home energy management systems
problem_type: home energy management control (safe RL, MPC, decision-tree policy)
real_world_setting: 4 real houses with PV, battery storage and EV charger
datasets_and_size: 48 valid experimental days (Apr-Jun 2024); 3 months of training data
claimed_novelty: First real-world side-by-side validation of safe RL, MPC and decision-tree energy management against rule-based control in houses.

title: Physics-Guided Memory Network for building energy modeling
problem_type: building energy forecasting (hybrid physics-guided deep learning)
real_world_setting: one student residence building (~495 residences), London, Ontario
datasets_and_size: hourly consumption of one building + EnergyPlus simulation outputs; scenarios with missing data, no history, infrastructure change
claimed_novelty: Memory-augmented network that fuses EnergyPlus and deep-learning forecasts and still works when either input is missing.

title: An empirical benchmark of deep time-series models for smart meter energy forecasting
problem_type: benchmark: household electricity forecasting with deep time-series models
real_world_setting: households in London (LCL) and US (Pecan Street)
datasets_and_size: LCL 5561 households, half-hourly, 829 days; Pecan Street 73 households, 15-min
stats_tests: Friedman test + Holm-corrected Wilcoxon signed-rank; household cluster bootstrap
claimed_novelty: Benchmark of nine deep forecasting architectures on smart-meter data with significance testing, efficiency and geodemographic subgroup analysis.

title: Evaluating rollout-verified reinforcement fine-tuning of a reasoning model for multi-zone variable-air-volume control
problem_type: HVAC control with reasoning LLM and reinforcement fine-tuning
real_world_setting: four-zone VAV system emulator (Tokyo weather)
datasets_and_size: simulation: 5 summer weekdays; 470 candidate actions for critic analysis
claimed_novelty: Tests whether rollout-verified reinforcement fine-tuning can improve a small open reasoning model as a multi-zone VAV controller, and shows a learned critic ranks actions unreliably.

title: Degradation-aligned self-supervised learning for state of health estimation of lithium-ion batteries under label sparsity
problem_type: battery state-of-health estimation (self-supervised learning)
real_world_setting: laboratory Li-ion cells (CALCE)
datasets_and_size: CALCE CX2 cells (4 cells), CC-charge voltage curves resampled to 300 points
claimed_novelty: Cycle-order ranking pretext task that aligns self-supervised pretraining with degradation, enabling SOH estimation with sparse labels.

title: Fast data augmentation for battery degradation prediction
problem_type: battery degradation prediction (synthetic data augmentation)
real_world_setting: laboratory cells and EV field data
datasets_and_size: 5 datasets: RWTH, Stanford, Oxford (8 cells), NASA (4 cells), field EV dataset (20 LFP cells)
claimed_novelty: A three-parameter capacity-fade function quickly generates synthetic degradation curves from small seed data to augment training of ML degradation predictors.

title: FETS Benchmark: Foundation Models Enable Scalable and Generalizable Energy Time Series Forecasting
problem_type: benchmark: energy time-series forecasting with foundation models
real_world_setting: multiple energy use cases (load, generation, prices etc.)
datasets_and_size: 54 datasets across 9 data categories
claimed_novelty: Stakeholder-based taxonomy plus a 54-dataset benchmark of time-series foundation models versus tuned tree models in zero-shot, covariate and fine-tuned modes.

title: Trustworthy and explainable deep reinforcement learning for safe and energy-efficient process control: A use case in industrial compressed air systems
problem_type: industrial process control (deep RL) with explainability
real_world_setting: compressed air system of a tool manufacturing plant (3 x 30 kW compressors)
datasets_and_size: simulation environment built from ~2 weeks of 5-s operational data
claimed_novelty: Deep RL pressure controller for compressed-air systems combined with layered explainability analysis to make the learned policy auditable.

title: Development of physics-consistent conditional diffusion model to overcome data scarcity in critical heat flux
problem_type: synthetic data generation (conditional diffusion) for critical heat flux
real_world_setting: nuclear thermal-hydraulics experimental CHF database
datasets_and_size: 24,579 CHF samples
claimed_novelty: Conditional diffusion model that generates physically consistent critical-heat-flux data at specified conditions, with uncertainty quantification.

title: A flow-based model for conditional and probabilistic electricity consumption profile generation
problem_type: residential load profile generation (normalizing flow)
real_world_setting: residential smart meter data from 5 countries
datasets_and_size: GE 2131 profiles; NL 27,757; AUS 10,000; UK 10,000 (+weather); USA 9110
claimed_novelty: Fully convolutional normalizing flow (FCPFlow) for conditional, probabilistic generation of residential daily load profiles.

title: HEAT: Hierarchical-constrained Encoder-Assisted Time series clustering for fault detection in district heating substations
problem_type: fault detection (unsupervised constrained clustering)
real_world_setting: district heating substations
datasets_and_size: UNVERIFIED
claimed_novelty: Constrained hierarchical clustering with a convolutional autoencoder approximates network topology so substations can be checked against neighbours for faults without labels.

title: Concept drift detection in district heating: A characterization framework and detector-centric benchmark
problem_type: concept drift detection benchmark for load forecasting
real_world_setting: district heating
datasets_and_size: DHDrift dataset: 9 drift scenarios (sudden/incremental, 3 severities) + real-world case
stats_tests: yes (statistical superiority claimed; test not named)
claimed_novelty: Characterisation framework and detector-centric benchmark of eight drift detectors on a district-heating drift dataset with known drift points.

title: From lab to practice: Towards a substation-invariant self-supervised transformer for low-label fault detection in district heating
problem_type: fault detection with few labels (self-supervised transformer)
real_world_setting: district heating substations (lab, simulation, field networks)
datasets_and_size: 6 datasets (laboratory emulations, simulation, real-world DH networks)
claimed_novelty: Self-supervised time-series transformer pretrained on unlabelled primary-side data for low-label substation fault detection, tested across domains.

title: Experimental validation of a neural-network-based method for fault detection in heat pump evaporators
problem_type: fault detection (ANN normal-behaviour model, evaporator fouling proxy)
real_world_setting: heat pump test rig (experimental)
datasets_and_size: UNVERIFIED
claimed_novelty: Experimental validation of an ANN residual-based detector of reduced evaporator air flow combining thresholding and Bayesian classification.

title: Physics-guided, noise-resilient and interpretable machine learning framework for fault detection and diagnosis in variable refrigerant flow systems
problem_type: fault detection and diagnosis (noise-resilient physics-guided classifiers)
real_world_setting: variable refrigerant flow (VRF) HVAC systems
datasets_and_size: UNVERIFIED
claimed_novelty: Adds curriculum Gaussian-noise augmentation and a physics-based probabilistic rule to standard classifiers for robust component-level VRF fault diagnosis.

title: Fault detection and diagnosis of electric bus air conditioning systems incorporating domain knowledge and probabilistic artificial intelligence
problem_type: fault detection and diagnosis (peer comparison + Gaussian process regression)
real_world_setting: electric city bus fleet air conditioners
datasets_and_size: UNVERIFIED
claimed_novelty: Unsupervised peer-group FDD for bus air conditioners that uses GPR uncertainty to discard unreliable predictions.

title: An enhanced semi-supervised learning method with self-supervised and adaptive threshold for fault detection and classification in urban power grids
problem_type: fault detection and classification (semi-supervised learning)
real_world_setting: urban power grid
datasets_and_size: own power grid dataset + 2 benchmark datasets
claimed_novelty: Semi-supervised framework with self-supervised loss and adaptive thresholds for grid fault classification with very few labels.

title: A holistic multimodal approach for real-time anomaly detection and classification in large-scale photovoltaic plants
problem_type: anomaly detection and classification (multimodal RGB/IR imagery)
real_world_setting: large-scale PV plants (research platform)
datasets_and_size: 1841 curated images, 5 anomaly classes
claimed_novelty: End-to-end pipeline that segments, geolocates and classifies PV modules from RGB and infrared images for real-time anomaly detection.

title: TRACE: Time series representation learning with contrastive embeddings for anomaly detection in photovoltaic systems
problem_type: anomaly detection (self-supervised contrastive time-series representation)
real_world_setting: PV inverters
datasets_and_size: real-world PV inverter dataset + 2 industrial benchmarks
claimed_novelty: Contrastive learning on autoencoder-perturbed reconstructions gives an unsupervised anomaly detector for PV inverter time series.

title: EGBAD: Ensemble graph-boosted anomaly detection for user-level multi-energy load data
problem_type: anomaly detection (graph + boosting ensemble)
real_world_setting: user-level multi-energy loads (integrated energy systems)
datasets_and_size: public real-world datasets (number not stated)
claimed_novelty: Builds dynamic graphs of multi-energy loads processed by a GCN inside a boosting loop to handle class imbalance in anomaly detection.

title: Detection of wind turbine rotor imbalance using unsupervised output-only vibration data analysis
problem_type: anomaly detection (extended isolation forest on vibration)
real_world_setting: 3 kW wind turbine adapted for laboratory use
datasets_and_size: 65 experiments with induced rotor imbalance plus healthy runs; triaxial accelerometers
claimed_novelty: Output-only vibration features with an extended isolation forest detect rotor imbalance using only healthy training data.

title: An open-weight Large Language Model agent for condition monitoring and predictive maintenance in wind energy systems
problem_type: condition monitoring / predictive maintenance (open-weight LLM agent)
real_world_setting: 2 MW wind turbine with documented gearbox-bearing failure
datasets_and_size: 30-day SCADA record; 24 held-out operator queries
claimed_novelty: Locally run open-weight LLM agent that calls deterministic monitoring tools to give grounded maintenance recommendations.

title: A physics-informed collaborative interpretable framework for wind turbine anomaly detection
problem_type: anomaly detection with interpretability (physics-informed clustering, SHAP, LIME)
real_world_setting: two wind farms (distinct climates)
datasets_and_size: SCADA with 78 features reduced to 11; 2 wind farms
claimed_novelty: Chains physics-informed feature clustering, SHAP and LIME into one interpretation framework for wind turbine anomaly detection.

title: Robust unsupervised gearbox fault detection under variable-speed operating conditions
problem_type: unsupervised gearbox fault detection under variable speed
real_world_setting: gearbox test data (wind turbine/rotating machinery context)
datasets_and_size: UNVERIFIED
claimed_novelty: Speed-invariant autoencoder working in the order domain with cross-speed interpolation to detect gear faults under varying speed using healthy data only.

title: Machine learning for photovoltaic single axis tracker fault detection and classification
problem_type: fault detection and classification (ML)
real_world_setting: PV single-axis tracker test system with emulated faults
datasets_and_size: UNVERIFIED
claimed_novelty: Machine learning framework for real-time detection and classification of single-axis tracker faults in PV plants.

title: Deep learning-based dual monitoring system for power forecasting and fault detection in nuclear power applications
problem_type: power forecasting + fault detection (attention-LSTM dual monitoring)
real_world_setting: two pressurized water reactor units (Units 5 and 6)
datasets_and_size: real-time data from 2 PWR units, 4 operational scenarios
claimed_novelty: Attention-augmented LSTM with a dual short/long-term monitoring scheme for reactor power prediction and fault detection.

title: Data-driven strategy for state of health prediction and anomaly detection in lithium-ion batteries
problem_type: battery SOH prediction + anomaly pattern mining
real_world_setting: laboratory Li-ion cells (MIT dataset)
datasets_and_size: MIT battery dataset
claimed_novelty: Explainable LSTM-based SOH predictors combined with pattern mining to flag abnormal SOH decline.

title: Ensemble learning for day-ahead district heat load forecasting: Base learners, ensemble structures, and combination rules across training data partitioning strategies
problem_type: day-ahead district heat load forecasting (ensemble learning)
real_world_setting: district heating (synthetic + operational network)
datasets_and_size: 1 synthetic + 1 operational real-world dataset
stats_tests: yes (statistically best model group; test not named)
claimed_novelty: Decomposes heat-load ensembles into base learner, structure and combination rule and quantifies each across five data partitioning strategies.

title: Heat pump detection and load disaggregation in low-resolution smart meter data with convolutional neural networks
problem_type: heat pump detection and load disaggregation (1D CNN)
real_world_setting: Swiss residential smart meters
datasets_and_size: >7000 heat pumps, low-resolution smart meter data
claimed_novelty: Rule-based heat pump detection plus a dedicated 1D CNN for disaggregating heat pump load from low-resolution household smart meter data.

title: Real-world self-adaptive digital twin: An example of commercial air-source heat pump
problem_type: self-adaptive digital twin (broad learning system)
real_world_setting: commercial air-source heat pump, hardware-in-the-loop
datasets_and_size: UNVERIFIED
claimed_novelty: Online parameter adaptation keeps a broad-learning-system digital twin of a heat pump consistent with the physical unit at second-level resolution.

title: Abnormal state detection of diesel engine with flexible monitoring thresholds
problem_type: abnormal state detection (entropy features + SVDD)
real_world_setting: six-cylinder diesel engine test, multiple loads
datasets_and_size: cylinder-head vibration dataset, multiple working conditions
claimed_novelty: Enhanced hierarchical fuzzy entropy features with parrot-optimised SVDD give automatic thresholds for engine anomaly detection.

title: A generative-enhanced temporal modeling framework for reliable anomaly detection in photovoltaic industrial systems
problem_type: anomaly detection with generative augmentation (TimesNet + cTimeGAN)
real_world_setting: grid-connected PV systems
datasets_and_size: GPVS-Faults benchmark
claimed_novelty: Pairs TimesNet with a conditional TimeGAN that synthesises minority fault samples to improve PV fault detection under imbalance.

title: Toward early battery anomaly detection: A multimodal dataset and deep learning framework for lithium-ion batteries
problem_type: early battery anomaly detection (multimodal autoencoder)
real_world_setting: pouch Li-ion cell lab cycling with induced faults
datasets_and_size: new multimodal dataset (electrical time series + thermal images), 4 induced fault types
claimed_novelty: New multimodal electrical-plus-thermal battery dataset and an unsupervised late-fusion autoencoder for early anomaly detection.

title: AI-Based automatic topology identification of photovoltaic (PV) systems using real-time data for topology-independent fault diagnosis
problem_type: PV array topology identification for fault diagnosis (physics-constrained RF)
real_world_setting: grid-connected PV, simulation + hardware-in-the-loop
datasets_and_size: 46,347 simulated PV samples (80:20 split) + HIL validation
claimed_novelty: Infers PV array topology from live measurements so that fault localisation no longer needs prior topology knowledge.
